verdict.rationale: Penpot explicitly lets users "choose where and how to host" their data. It supports private cloud, on-premise, or any environment the user controls, with official Docker Compose, Helm, OpenShift and Rancher deployments, and community users confirm they self-host it. The MCP server can also be deployed in your own environment without third-party clouds. Residency control comes through running the infrastructure yourself, not through a region picker. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted cloud offering, and documented data-residency or compliance guarantees.
